teaser: Seven on a weeknight, a choir warms up in a cold room, and you are the one who already has the folders handed out before the director asks. Life path 3 is called the Creative, built to speak and lift a room with words; ESTJ is built to organize that room so the words land on time. Crossed, you get someone who does not just feel the joy, but schedules it, rehearses it, makes sure the punchline or the chorus lands exactly when it is supposed to. The charm is real. So is the clipboard underneath it.
excerpt: Who gets asked to dance, and who already knows the song before it starts.
